body.name: MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Records (MEGDR)
body.scientific_limitations: Spatial resolution limited to ~463 m; polar gap beyond 88° latitude; microtopography (<100m) not resolved.
body.provenance_source: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Geosciences Node / Smith et al. (2001)

body.name: HRSC High Resolution Stereo Camera DTMs
body.coverage: Regional orbital swaths (covering ~50%–70% of Martian surface)
body.scientific_limitations: Non-contiguous strip coverage; precision depends on stereo convergence angle and atmospheric dust optical depth.
body.provenance_source: ESA Planetary Science Archive / DLR Institute of Planetary Research / Gwinner et al. (2010)

body.name: HiRISE High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment DTMs
body.coverage: Targeted candidate landing sites and high-priority scientific targets (<0.1% global coverage)
body.scientific_limitations: Extremely sparse spatial footprint (~5 km x 20 km swaths); DTM edges contain photogrammetric interpolation artifacts.
body.provenance_source: University of Arizona Lunar & Planetary Laboratory / NASA PDS / McEwen et al. (2007)

body.name: CTX Context Camera Stereo DTMs
body.coverage: Regional corridors around major craters, rift canyons, and landing sites (~5%–10% of surface)
body.scientific_limitations: Stereo pairs processed on demand via NASA Ames Stereo Pipeline; gaps between non-overlapping orbits.
body.provenance_source: NASA Ames Stereo Pipeline (ASP) / Murray Lab Caltech / Malin et al. (2007)
